S0118_2.or: Deus, qui beáto Petro Apóstolo tuo, collátis clávibus regni cæléstis, ligándi atque solvéndi pontifícium tradidísti: concéde, ut intercessiónis ejus auxílio; a peccatórum nostrórum néxibus liberémur: Qui vivis.
S0118_2.se: Ecclésiæ tuæ, quǽsumus Dómine, preces et hóstias beáti Petri Apóstoli tui comméndet orátio: ut quod pro illíus glória celebrámus, nobis prosit ad véniam. Per Dóminum.
S0118_2.pc: Lætíficet nos, Dómine quǽsumus, munus oblátum: ut sicut in Apóstolo tuo Petro te mirábilem prædicámus; sic per illum tuæ sumámus indulgéntiæ largitátem: Per Dóminum.

en.or: O God, who, giving to blessed Peter, Your apostle, the keys of the heavenly kingdom, bestowed on him the power of binding and loosing; grant that by the help of his intercession we may be set free from the bonds of our sins
en.se: May the prayer of blessed Peter, Your apostle, commend to You, we beseech You, O Lord, the prayers and offerings of Your Church; that what we celebrate for his glory may profit us for pardon
en.pc: May the gift we have offered gladden us, we beseech You, O Lord; that as in Peter Your apostle we proclaim You wonderful, so through him we may receive the bounty of Your forgiveness

S0203.or: Da, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut qui beáti Blásii Mártyris tui atque Pontíficis solémnia cólimus; ejus apud te intercessiónibus adjuvémur: Per Dóminum.
S0203.se: Hæc hóstia, quǽsumus Dómine, emúndet nostra delícta: et ad sacrifícium celebrándum, subditórum tibi córpora mentésque sanctíficet. Per Dóminum.
S0203.pc: Refécti participatióne múneris sacri, quǽsumus Dómine Deus noster: ut cujus exséquimur cultum; intercedénte beáto Blásio Mártyre tuo atque Pontífice, sentiámus efféctum: Per Dóminum.

en.or: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that we who keep the feast of blessed Blaise, Your martyr and bishop, may be helped by his intercession with You
en.se: May this victim, we beseech You, O Lord, cleanse our sins, and sanctify the bodies and minds of Your servants for the offering of this sacrifice
en.pc: Refreshed by partaking of the sacred gift, we beseech You, O Lord our God, that, at the intercession of blessed Blaise, Your martyr and bishop, we may feel the effect of the rite we perform

S0312.or: Deus, qui nos beáti Gregórii Confessóris tui atque Pontíficis ánnua solemnitáte lætíficas: concéde propítius, ut cujus ópere atque doctrína Scriptúræ tuæ mystéria multa cognóvimus; ejus apud te semper patrocínia sentiámus: Per Dóminum.
S0312.se: Annue nobis, quǽsumus Dómine, ut intercessióne beáti Gregórii hæc nobis prosit oblátio, quam immolándo totíus mundi tribuísti relaxári delícta. Per Dóminum.
S0312.pc: Deus, qui beátum Gregórium Pontíficem Sanctórum tuórum méritis coæquásti: concéde propítius, ut qui commemoratiónis ejus festa percólimus; vitæ quoque imitémur exémpla: Per Dóminum.

en.or: O God, who gladden us by the yearly feast of blessed Gregory, Your confessor and bishop; mercifully grant that we who through his work and teaching have come to know many mysteries of Your Scripture may ever feel his patronage before You
en.se: Grant us, we pray You, O Lord, that through the intercession of blessed Gregory this offering may profit us, by whose immolation You have granted the sins of the whole world to be loosed
en.pc: O God, who made blessed Gregory, the pontiff, equal in merit to Your saints; grant in Your mercy that we who keep the feast of his commemoration may also follow the example of his life

S0318.or: Da nobis, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: beáto Cyríllo Pontífice intercedénte, Te solum verum Deum, et quem misísti Jesum Christum, ita cognóscere; ut inter oves, quæ vocem ejus áudiunt, perpétuo connumerári mereámur: Per eúmdem Dóminum.
S0318.se: Réspice Dómine, immaculátam hóstiam, quam tibi offérimus: et præsta; ut méritis beáti Pontíficis et Confessóris tui Cyrílli, eam mundo corde suscípere studeámus. Per Dóminum.
S0318.pc: Sacraménta Córporis et Sánguinis tui, quæ súmpsimus, Dómine Jesu Christe, beáti Cyrílli Pontíficis précibus, mentes et corda nostra sanctíficent; ut divínæ consórtes natúræ éffici mereámur: Qui vivis et regnas.

en.or: Grant us, we beseech You, almighty God, through the intercession of blessed Cyril, bishop, so to know You, the only true God, and Jesus Christ whom You have sent, that we may deserve to be numbered for ever among the sheep that hear His voice
en.se: Look, O Lord, upon the spotless victim which we offer You, and grant that by the merits of blessed Cyril, Your bishop and confessor, we may strive to receive it with a clean heart
en.pc: May the sacraments of Your Body and Blood which we have received, O Lord Jesus Christ, sanctify our minds and hearts through the prayers of blessed Cyril, bishop, that we may be made worthy to become partakers of the divine nature

S0503.or: Deus, qui in præclára salutíferæ Crucis Inventióne, passiónis tuæ mirácula suscitásti; concéde, ut vitális ligni prétio, ætérnæ vitæ suffrágia consequámur: Qui vivis.
S0503.se: Sacrifícium, Dómine, quod tibi immolámus, placátus inténde: ut ab omni nos éruat bellórum nequítia; et per vexíllum sanctæ Crucis Fílii tui, ad conteréndas potestátis advérsæ insídias, nos in tuæ protectiónis securitáte constítuat. Per eúmdem Dóminum.
S0503.pc: Ineffábilem cleméntiam tuam quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut ab iis, quos per lignum sanctæ Crucis pio cruóre Fílii tui redemísti, dira serpéntis antíqui venéna depéllas; et eis per grátiam Sancti Spíritus póculum salútis infúndas: Per eúmdem Dóminum.

en.or: O God, who in the glorious finding of the saving Cross renewed the wonders of Your passion; grant that by the price paid on the life-giving tree we may obtain the help of eternal life
en.se: Look graciously, O Lord, upon the sacrifice we offer You, that it may deliver us from all the evil of war, and through the standard of the holy Cross of Your Son establish us in the safety of Your protection, to crush the snares of the enemy power
en.pc: We beseech Your ineffable mercy, almighty God, that from those whom You have redeemed by the tree of the holy Cross through the loving Blood of Your Son You would drive away the deadly poisons of the ancient serpent, and pour into them by the grace of the Holy Spirit the cup of salvation

S0506.or: Deus, qui cónspicis quia nos úndique mala nostra pertúrbant; præsta quǽsumus, ut beáti Joánnis Apóstoli tui et Evangelístæ intercéssio gloriósa nos prótegat: Per Dóminum.
S0506.se: Munéribus nostris, quǽsumus Dómine, precibúsque suscéptis, et cæléstibus nos munda mystériis, et cleménter exáudi. Per Dóminum.
S0506.pc: Refécti, Dómine, pane cælésti; ad vitam, quǽsumus, nutriámur ætérnam: Per Dóminum.

en.or: O God, who see that our evils trouble us on every side; grant, we beseech You, that the glorious intercession of blessed John, Your apostle and evangelist, may protect us
en.se: Receive our gifts and prayers, we beseech You, O Lord; cleanse us by these heavenly mysteries and graciously hear us
en.pc: Refreshed with heavenly bread, O Lord, may we be nourished, we beseech You, unto life eternal

S0508_2.or: Deus, qui miro órdine Angelórum ministéria, hominúmque dispénsas; concéde propítius: ut a quibus tibi ministrántibus in cælo semper assístitur; ab his in terra vita nostra muniátur: Per Dóminum.
S0508_2.se: Hóstias tibi, Dómine, laudis offérimus, supplíciter deprecántes: ut eásdem, Angélico pro nobis interveniénte suffrágio, et placátus accípias, et ad salútem nostram proveníre concédas. Per Dóminum.
S0508_2.pc: Beáti Archángeli tui Michaélis intercessióne suffúlti, súpplices te, Dómine, deprecámur: ut quod ore proséquimur; contingámus et mente: Per Dóminum.

en.or: O God, who in wonderful order dispose the ministries of angels and of men; mercifully grant that our life on earth may be defended by those who ever stand ministering before You in heaven
en.se: We offer You sacrifices of praise, O Lord, humbly beseeching You that, with the angelic prayer interceding for us, You may graciously accept them and grant that they may avail for our salvation
en.pc: Upheld by the intercession of blessed Michael, Your archangel, we humbly beseech You, O Lord, that what we pursue with our lips we may attain with our minds

S0513b.or: Dómine Jesu Christe, qui beátam Vírginem Iméldam igníto caritátis amóre sauciátam et immaculáta hóstia mirabíliter refectam, in cælum suscepísti: fac nos ejus intercessióne, eódem caritátis fervóre ad Sacram Mensam accédere; ut appetámus dissólvi, et esse tecum mereámur: Qui vivis et regnas.
S0513b.se: Súscipe, Dómine, múnera quæ tibi offérimus, et beátæ Iméldæ Vírginis intercedéntibus méritis, amóris tui nobis spíritum infúnde, ut terrénis affectiónibus despéctis, in te nostra fixa sint corda, ubi vera sunt gáudia. Per Dóminum.
S0513b.pc: Sit nobis, Dómine, ad thronum misericórdiæ Tuæ pro nobis beáta Imélda virgo indefíciens exorátrix: ut sicut illa salutári hóstia percépta ad ætérnam glóriam evolávit; ita tanti participátio mystérii sit nobis ablútio scélerum in vita, et in morte via, qua ad vitam perveniámus ætérnam: Per Dóminum.

en.or: O Lord Jesus Christ, who took up into heaven the blessed virgin Imelda, wounded with the burning love of charity and wonderfully refreshed with the spotless Host; grant that by her intercession we may approach the Holy Table with the same fervor of charity, that we may long to be dissolved and deserve to be with You
en.se: Receive, O Lord, the gifts which we offer You, and through the merits of blessed Imelda, virgin, pour into us the spirit of Your love, that with earthly affections despised our hearts may be fixed on You, where true joys are
en.pc: May blessed Imelda, virgin, be for us, O Lord, an unfailing pleader before the throne of Your mercy; that as she, having received the saving Host, flew up to eternal glory, so the sharing of so great a mystery may be for us in life the cleansing of our sins, and in death the way by which we may come to life eternal

S0516.or: Deus, qui ob invíctum beáti Joánnis sacramentále siléntium, nova Ecclésiam tuam martýrii coróna decorásti: da nobis ejus intercessióne et exémplo, linguam caute custodíre; et ómnia pótius mala quam ánimæ detriméntum in hoc sǽculo toleráre: Per Dóminum.
S0516.se: Per hæc tua, Dómine, sacra mystéria, illo nos caritátis igne accendámur, quo invíctus Martyr Joánnes eádem peragéndo flagrábat. Per Dóminum.
S0516.pc: Spíritum, Dómine, fortitúdinis hæc nobis tríbuat mensa cæléstis; quæ beáti Mártyris tui Joánnis contra sacraménti honórem tentátam constántiam júgiter áluit ad victóriam. Per Dóminum.

en.or: O God, who for the unconquered sacramental silence of blessed John adorned Your Church with a new crown of martyrdom; grant us by his intercession and example to guard our tongue carefully, and to suffer all evils in this world rather than the loss of our soul
en.se: Through these Your sacred mysteries, O Lord, may we be set on fire with that flame of charity with which John, the unconquered martyr, burned in celebrating them
en.pc: May this heavenly table grant us, O Lord, the spirit of fortitude, which ever nourished unto victory the constancy of blessed John, Your martyr, when it was tried against the honor of the sacrament

S0522.or: Exáudi, quǽsumus Dómine, preces nostras, quas in beáti Servátii Confessóris tui atque Pontíficis solemnitáte deférimus: ut qui tibi digne méruit famulári; ejus intercedéntibus méritis, ab ómnibus nos absólvas peccátis: Per Dóminum.
S0522.se: Accépta sit in conspéctu tuo Dómine nostra devótio: ut ejus nobis fiat supplicatióne salutáris, pro cujus solemnitáte defértur: Per Dóminum.
S0522.pc: Da, quǽsumus Dómine, fidélibus tuis, Sanctórum tuórum semper veneratióne lætári; et eórum perpétua supplicatióne muníri: Per Dóminum.

en.or: Hear, we beseech You, O Lord, the prayers which we offer on the feast of blessed Servatius, Your confessor and bishop; that by the merits and intercession of him who was found worthy to serve You, You may absolve us from all our sins
en.se: May our devotion be acceptable in Your sight, O Lord, that it may profit us for salvation through the pleading of him on whose feast it is offered
en.pc: Grant to Your faithful, we beseech You, O Lord, ever to rejoice in the veneration of Your saints, and to be fortified by their unceasing prayer

S0525.or: Da, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut qui beáti Urbáni Mártyris tui atque Pontíficis solémnia cólimus; ejus apud te intercessiónibus adjuvémur: Per Dóminum.
S0525.se: Hæc hóstia, quǽsumus Dómine, emúndet nostra delícta: et ad sacrifícium celebrándum, subditórum tibi córpora mentésque sanctíficet. Per Dóminum.
S0525.pc: Refécti participatióne múneris sacri, quǽsumus Dómine Deus noster: ut cujus exséquimur cultum; intercedénte beáto Urbáno Mártyre tuo atque Pontífice, sentiámus efféctum: Per Dóminum.

en.or: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that we who keep the feast of blessed Urban, Your martyr and bishop, may be helped by his intercession with You
en.se: May this victim, we beseech You, O Lord, cleanse our sins, and sanctify the bodies and minds of Your servants for the offering of this sacrifice
en.pc: Refreshed by partaking of the sacred gift, we beseech You, O Lord our God, that, at the intercession of blessed Urban, Your martyr and bishop, we may feel the effect of the rite we perform

S0615.or: Da Ecclésiæ tuæ, quǽsumus Dómine, sanctis Martýribus tuis Vito, Modésto, atque Crescéntia intercedéntibus, supérbe non sápere; sed tibi plácita humilitáte profícere: ut prava despíciens; quæcúmque recta sunt, líbera exérceat caritáte: Per Dóminum.
S0615.se: Sicut glóriam divínæ poténtiæ, múnera pro Sanctis obláta testántur: sic nobis efféctum, Dómine, tuæ salvatiónis impéndant. Per Dóminum.
S0615.pc: Refécti, Dómine, benedictióne solémni, quǽsumus: ut per intercessiónem sanctórum Mártyrum tuórum Viti, Modésti, et Crescéntiæ; medicína sacraménti et corpóribus nostris prosit, et méntibus: Per Dóminum.

en.or: Grant to Your Church, we beseech You, O Lord, through the intercession of Your holy martyrs Vitus, Modestus and Crescentia, not to think proudly, but to advance in a humility pleasing to You; that, despising what is wrong, she may practise with free charity whatever things are right
en.se: As the gifts offered in honor of Your saints bear witness to the glory of Your divine power, so may they bring us, O Lord, the effect of Your salvation
en.pc: Refreshed by this solemn blessing, we beseech You, O Lord, that through the intercession of Your holy martyrs Vitus, Modestus and Crescentia, the healing power of this sacrament may profit us both in body and in mind

S0801.or: Deus, qui beátum Petrum Apóstolum, a vínculis absolútum, illǽsum abíre fecísti: nostrórum, quǽsumus, absólve víncula peccatórum; et ómnia mala a nobis propitiátus exclúde: Per Dóminum.
S0801.se: Oblátum tibi Dómine sacrifícium, intercedénte beáto Petro Apóstolo tuo, vivíficet nos semper, et múniat. Per Dóminum.
S0801.pc: Córporis sacri et pretiósi Sánguinis repléti libámine, quǽsumus Dómine Deus noster: ut quod pia devotióne gérimus; certa redemptióne capiámus: Per eúmdem Dóminum.

en.or: O God, who loosed blessed Peter, the apostle, from his chains and made him go forth unharmed; loose, we beseech You, the chains of our sins, and in Your mercy ward off all evils from us
en.se: May the sacrifice offered to You, O Lord, at the intercession of blessed Peter, Your apostle, ever quicken and defend us
en.pc: Filled with the draught of the sacred Body and precious Blood, we beseech You, O Lord our God, that what we perform with loving devotion we may receive as sure redemption

S0813.or: Da, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut beáti Hippólyti Mártyris tui, sociorúmque ejus veneránda solémnitas; et devotiónem nobis áugeat, et salútem: Per Dóminum.
S0813.se: Réspice Dómine múnera pópuli tui, Sanctórum festivitáte votíva: et tuæ testificátio veritátis nobis profíciat ad salútem. Per Dóminum.
S0813.pc: Sacramentórum tuórum, Dómine, commúnio sumpta nos salvet; et in tuæ veritátis luce confírmet: Per Dóminum.

en.or: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that the venerable feast of blessed Hippolytus, Your martyr, and of his companions, may increase in us both devotion and salvation
en.se: Look, O Lord, upon the gifts of Your people, offered on the feast of Your saints; and may the witness they bore to Your truth profit us unto salvation
en.pc: May the communion of Your sacraments which we have received save us, O Lord, and confirm us in the light of Your truth

S0910_2.or: Concéde, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut Ecclésia tua, quæ beáti Nicolái Confessóris tui virtútum et miraculórum glória corúscat; ejus intercessióne et méritis, perpétua pace atque unitáte lætétur: Per Dóminum.
S0910_2.se: Oblátum tibi Dómine sacrifícium, intercedénte beáto Nicoláo Confessóre tuo, vivíficet nos semper, et múniat. Per Dóminum.
S0910_2.pc: Pópulum tuum Dómine, quæ súmpsimus, sacraménta custódiant: ut qui sancti Nicolái Confessóris tui júgiter implórant auxílium; petitiónum suárum salutárem consequántur efféctum: Per Dóminum.

en.or: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that Your Church, which shines with the glory of the virtues and miracles of blessed Nicholas, Your confessor, may by his intercession and merits rejoice in lasting peace and unity
en.se: May the sacrifice offered to You, O Lord, at the intercession of blessed Nicholas, Your confessor, ever quicken and defend us
en.pc: May the sacraments we have received guard Your people, O Lord, that those who constantly implore the help of Saint Nicholas, Your confessor, may obtain the saving effect of their petitions

S0917.or: Dómine Jesu Christe, qui frigescénte mundo, ad inflammánda corda nostra tui amóris igne, in carne beáti Francísci passiónis tuæ sacra Stígmata renovásti: concéde propítius, ut ejus méritis et précibus crucem júgiter ferámus; et dignos fructus pœniténtiæ faciámus: Qui vivis.
S0917.se: Múnera tibi, Dómine, dicáta sanctífica: et intercedénte beáto Francísco, ab omni nos culpárum labe purífica. Per Dóminum.
S0917.pc: Deus, qui mira Crucis mystéria in beáto Francísco Confessóre tuo multifórmiter demonstrásti: da nobis, quǽsumus, devotiónis suæ semper exémpla sectári; et assídua ejúsdem Crucis meditatióne muníri: Per Dóminum.

en.or: O Lord Jesus Christ, who, when the world was growing cold, renewed the sacred marks of Your passion in the flesh of blessed Francis, to inflame our hearts with the fire of Your love; mercifully grant that by his merits and prayers we may ever carry the cross and bring forth fruits worthy of penance
en.se: Sanctify, O Lord, the gifts dedicated to You, and at the intercession of blessed Francis cleanse us from every stain of sin
en.pc: O God, who in manifold ways showed forth the wonderful mysteries of the Cross in blessed Francis, Your confessor; grant us, we beseech You, ever to follow the example of his devotion and to be strengthened by constant meditation on the same Cross

S0922.or: Annue, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut sanctórum Mártyrum tuórum Maurítii, Exsupérii, Cándidi, Vitális, Innocéntii, ac sociórum eorúmdem nos lætíficet festíva solémnitas; ut quorum suffrágiis nítimur, eórum natalítiis gloriémur: Per Dóminum.
S0922.se: Réspice, quǽsumus Dómine, múnera, quæ in sanctórum Mártyrum tuórum Maurítii, Exsupérii, Cándidi, Vitális, Innocéntii, ac sociórum eorúmdem commemoratióne deférimus: et præsta, ut quorum honóre sunt grata, eórum nobis fiant intercessióne perpétua. Per Dóminum.
S0922.pc: Cæléstibus refécti sacraméntis et gáudiis, súpplices te rogámus, omnípotens Deus: ut quorum gloriámur triúmphis; protegámur auxíliis: Per Dóminum.

en.or: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that the festal solemnity of Your holy martyrs Maurice, Exuperius, Candidus, Vitalis, Innocent and their companions may gladden us; that we may glory in the heavenly birthdays of those on whose prayers we rely
en.se: Look, we beseech You, O Lord, upon the gifts which we offer in commemoration of Your holy martyrs Maurice, Exuperius, Candidus, Vitalis, Innocent and their companions; and grant that as they are pleasing for their honor, so by their intercession they may profit us for ever
en.pc: Refreshed by heavenly sacraments and joys, we humbly beseech You, almighty God, that we may be protected by the help of those in whose triumphs we glory

S1009_2.or: Deus, qui hodiérna die beátum Dionýsium Mártyrem tuum atque Pontíficem virtúte constántiæ in passióne roborásti; quique illi ad prædicándum géntibus glóriam tuam, Rústicum et Eleuthérium sociáre dignátus es: tríbue nobis, quǽsumus, eórum imitatióne pro amóre tuo próspera mundi despícere; et nulla ejus advérsa formidáre: Per Dóminum.
S1009_2.se: Hóstia, Dómine quǽsumus, quam sanctórum Mártyrum tuórum Dionýsii, Rústici, et Eleuthérii natalítia recenséntes offérimus, et víncula nostræ pravitátis absólvat, et tuæ nobis misericórdiæ dona concíliet. Per Dóminum.
S1009_2.pc: Quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut qui cæléstia aliménta percépimus; intercedéntibus sanctis Martýribus tuis Dionýsio, Rústico, et Eleuthério, per hæc contra ómnia advérsa muniámur: Per Dóminum.

en.or: O God, who on this day strengthened blessed Denis, Your martyr and bishop, with the virtue of constancy in his passion, and were pleased to join to him Rusticus and Eleutherius for preaching Your glory to the Gentiles; grant us, we beseech You, by imitating them, to despise for love of You the prosperity of the world and to fear none of its adversities
en.se: May the victim which we offer, O Lord, recalling the heavenly birthday of Your holy martyrs Denis, Rusticus and Eleutherius, loose the bonds of our wickedness and win for us the gifts of Your mercy
en.pc: We beseech You, almighty God, that we who have received this heavenly food may, through the intercession of Your holy martyrs Denis, Rusticus and Eleutherius, be defended by it against all adversities

S1031.or: Deus, qui hanc sacrosánctam ecclésiam tot voluísti Sanctórum decorári Relíquiis: concéde nobis fámulis tuis, ut quorum memóriam venerámur in terris; eórum consórtio perfruámur in cælis: Per Dóminum.
S1031.se: Múnera tua, miséricors Deus, majestáti tuæ obláta benígno, quǽsumus, súscipe intúitu: ut eórum nobis précibus fiant salutária, quorum benedíctas in ecclésia ista Relíquias venerámur. Per Dóminum.
S1031.pc: Divína, Dómine, libántes mystéria, te deprecámur: ut per mérita Sanctórum, quorum venerábiles Relíquiæ in ista requiéscunt ecclésia, peccatórum nostrórum véniam mereámur; et cæléstis grátiæ donis reficiámur: Per Dóminum.

en.or: O God, who willed that this holy church should be adorned with the relics of so many saints; grant to us Your servants that we may enjoy in heaven the fellowship of those whose memory we venerate on earth
en.se: Receive with a gracious regard, we beseech You, O God of mercy, Your gifts offered to Your majesty; that they may become saving for us through the prayers of those whose blessed relics we venerate in this church
en.pc: Partaking of the divine mysteries, O Lord, we beseech You that through the merits of the saints whose venerable relics rest in this church, we may obtain pardon for our sins and be refreshed with the gifts of heavenly grace

S1210.or: Deus, qui beátæ Maríæ Vírginis Domum per incarnáti Verbi mystérium misericórditer consecrásti: eámque in sinu Ecclésiæ tuæ mirabíliter collocásti; concéde, ut segregáti a tabernáculis peccatórum, digni efficiámur habitatóres domus sanctæ tuæ: Per eúmdem.
S1210.se: Accipe, quǽsumus Dómine, múnera in hac sacra Domo dignánter obláta: et beátæ Maríæ Vírginis suffragántibus méritis, ad nostræ salútis auxílium proveníre concéde. Per Dóminum.
S1210.pc: Quǽsumus Dómine Deus noster: ut sacrosáncta mystéria, quæ pro reparatiónis nostræ munímine contulísti; intercedénte beáta María semper Vírgine, et præsens nobis remédium esse fácias, et futúrum: Per Dóminum.

en.or: O God, who in Your mercy consecrated the House of the blessed Virgin Mary by the mystery of the Word made flesh, and wonderfully placed it in the bosom of Your Church; grant that, set apart from the tents of sinners, we may be made worthy dwellers in Your holy house
en.se: Receive, we beseech You, O Lord, the gifts graciously offered in this holy House, and by the pleading merits of the blessed Virgin Mary grant that they may avail for the help of our salvation
en.pc: We beseech You, O Lord our God, that through the intercession of blessed Mary ever Virgin, You would make the most holy mysteries which You have given us for the safeguarding of our restoration a remedy both present and to come

S1229.or: Deus, pro cujus Ecclésia gloriósus Póntifex Thomas gládiis impiórum occúbuit: præsta quǽsumus, ut omnes, qui ejus implórant auxílium; petitiónis suæ salutárem consequántur efféctum: Per Dóminum.
S1229.se: Hæc hóstia, quǽsumus Dómine, emúndet nostra delícta: et ad sacrifícium celebrándum, subditórum tibi córpora mentésque sanctíficet. Per Dóminum.
S1229.pc: Refécti participatióne múneris sacri, quǽsumus Dómine Deus noster: ut cujus exséquimur cultum; intercedénte beáto Thoma Mártyre tuo atque Pontífice, sentiámus efféctum: Per Dóminum.

en.or: O God, for whose Church the glorious bishop Thomas fell by the swords of the wicked; grant, we beseech You, that all who implore his help may obtain the saving effect of their petition
en.se: May this victim, we beseech You, O Lord, cleanse our sins, and sanctify the bodies and minds of Your servants for the offering of this sacrifice
en.pc: Refreshed by partaking of the sacred gift, we beseech You, O Lord our God, that, at the intercession of blessed Thomas, Your martyr and bishop, we may feel the effect of the rite we perform

S1231.or: Da, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut beáti Silvéstri Confessóris tui atque Pontíficis veneránda solémnitas; et devotiónem nobis áugeat, et salútem: Per Dóminum.
S1231.se: Sancti tui nos, Dómine quǽsumus, ubíque lætíficent: ut dum eórum mérita recólimus, patrocínia sentiámus. Per Dóminum.
S1231.pc: Præsta, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut de percéptis munéribus grátias exhibéntes; intercedénte beáto Silvéstro Confessóre tuo atque Pontífice, benefícia potióra sumámus: Per Dóminum.

en.or: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that the venerable feast of blessed Sylvester, Your confessor and bishop, may increase in us both devotion and salvation
en.se: Let Your saints, we beseech You, O Lord, everywhere make us glad; that while we remember their merits we may experience their help
en.pc: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that giving thanks for the gifts received, we may, through the intercession of blessed Sylvester, Your confessor and bishop, obtain still greater benefits
